{
  "project_id": "P-UGA-IntegratedWaterMgmtDev",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Regional instability from the South Sudan conflict may increase refugee inflows, overwhelming water and sanitation services.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Establish a joint coordination task force with UNHCR and ministries to monitor refugee movements, adjust water allocations, and secure contingency funding.",
      "evidence": "Continuation of this conflict could affect export earnings and place an excessive amount of pressure on Uganda’s public services and natural resources."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Rapid population growth and urbanisation will outpace planned water‑service expansion, leading to unmet demand.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement phased roll‑out, update demand forecasts regularly, and prioritize high‑growth towns for early investment.",
      "evidence": "Uganda’s population of 35 million is expected to reach 80 million by 2040; about 60 % of the current urban population lacks basic amenities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Climate change‑driven extreme temperature and precipitation variability may cause droughts and floods, threatening water availability.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Integrate climate‑resilient designs, expand water storage, implement catchment protection, and develop flood‑early‑warning systems.",
      "evidence": "A high-level screening for climate change and disaster risks identified extreme temperature, increased precipitation variability and likely floods."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Delayed construction and cost overruns due to incomplete designs and insufficient geotechnical studies.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Require detailed feasibility and geotechnical studies before tendering; include contingency budgets and design‑review checkpoints.",
      "evidence": "Delayed construction and underestimation of the cost of works attributed to preparation of designs; incomplete needs assessments and inadequate attention to geotechnical studies."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Limited capacity of domestic contractors to execute complex WSS projects may force reliance on international firms, raising costs.",
      "category": "procurement",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct market sounding, pre‑qualify joint‑venture consortia, and provide capacity‑building grants for local firms.",
      "evidence": "Limited capacity of domestic contractors to conduct projects of this nature, complexity, and scope."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Weak procurement and contract‑management capacity in MWE and NWSC could cause delays and errors in procurement cycles.",
      "category": "procurement",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire experienced procurement consultants, deliver targeted training on World Bank procurement rules, and establish a contract‑management office.",
      "evidence": "PDU staff have no experience in IDA procurement; heavy workload leading to delays at each stage of the procurement cycle."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "The IFMS project module is not operational, risking inaccurate financial reporting and delayed disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize full IFMS module rollout, implement parallel manual reconciliations, and schedule quarterly audit reviews.",
      "evidence": "IFMS is currently only operational for government funds as the project module is not yet fully operational."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Turnover of qualified staff in MWE and NWSC may disrupt implementation continuity.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Introduce retention incentives, succession planning, and knowledge‑transfer documentation for key positions.",
      "evidence": "Turnover of qualified and experienced staff is noticed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "NWSC may lack capacity to manage the additional 204 small‑town schemes, affecting service quality.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Phase the transfer of schemes, strengthen UWA support, and use professionalisation contracts for operational assistance.",
      "evidence": "NWSC does not have capacity to assume management of all Uganda’s 1,000 plus small‑ to medium‑size schemes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Tariffs may not keep pace with regional cost variations, jeopardising cost‑recovery and financial sustainability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement automatic tariff adjustment mechanisms linked to cost indices and conduct annual cost reviews.",
      "evidence": "Tariffs must automatically adjust to cost variations; financial viability depends on tariff adjustments."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Debt service on the IDA loan could strain NWSC cash‑flow and limit investment capacity.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Stagger repayments, maintain a reserve fund, and explore commercial financing to diversify funding sources.",
      "evidence": "Annual payments of principal and service charge would correspond to less than 1.4 % of total annual revenues after 2025."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Labor influx for construction may increase gender‑based violence and community tensions.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt a Labor Influx Management Plan, enforce a code of conduct, and conduct community sensitisation on GBV prevention.",
      "evidence": "Labor influx... may lead to GBV; measures include code of conduct and labor influx management plan."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Water abstraction could reduce minimum environmental flows, harming downstream ecosystems and users.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Install flow‑monitoring devices, enforce minimum EF thresholds, and design intakes with protective features.",
      "evidence": "Minimum EF may not be sufficient during dry season; downstream users could be affected if minimum EF is not maintained."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Handling of asbestos‑cement pipes poses health and environmental hazards if not managed properly.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Follow NEMA asbestos handling guidelines, train workers, and ensure safe disposal in licensed facilities.",
      "evidence": "Management measures for removal, packaging, transportation and disposal of existing asbestos waste, following guidance from NEMA."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Insufficient community engagement could lead to opposition, misuse of facilities, or delays.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement systematic community consultations, establish local supervision committees, and operate a grievance redress mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Project will engage participating communities throughout the cycle; grievance redress system will address complaints."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Inadequate catchment protection may cause source degradation and reduced water quality.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop and enforce catchment protection plans, including fencing, reforestation, and community‑based stewardship programs.",
      "evidence": "Catchment management measures will include fencing/marking of buffer zones, planting appropriate grass and tree species, and creating diversion channels."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Insufficient O&M funding for new infrastructure could lead to rapid deterioration.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Allocate dedicated O&M budgets, establish a revolving financing facility, and ensure tariffs cover O&M plus a margin.",
      "evidence": "UWAs can cover routine O&M but do not generate enough revenue to cover capital investments; financing gap exists."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Delay in executing the subsidiary agreement and other legal covenants may postpone fund disbursement.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Monitor legal documentation progress, set internal deadlines, and engage legal counsel to expedite signing.",
      "evidence": "Subsidiary Agreement must be executed; effectiveness condition includes execution of the agreement."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Increased flood risk due to climate change could damage water‑infrastructure.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Design flood‑resilient structures, elevate critical assets, and incorporate river‑bank restoration measures.",
      "evidence": "Floods... hazardous to local communities; mitigation includes restoration of riverine vegetation and buffer zone protection."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Projected GHG emission reductions may be over‑estimated, affecting climate‑co‑benefit claims.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Implement a monitoring framework to measure actual emissions and adjust reporting as needed.",
      "evidence": "GHG emissions are global externalities; net emissions estimated at –8,124 tCO2eq, but impact is small."
    }
  ]
}
